channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Over 50 Decomposing Bodies Found at Far South Side Funeral Home
item.description: Authorities launched an investigation after discovering more than 50 decomposing bodies at a funeral home on the Far South Side.

item.title: Thailand school shooting leaves at least six dead after suspect kills grandparents
item.description: A teenager reportedly described as troubled by a classmate killed his grandparents before shooting at least six others at a school in Thailand.

item.title: Fan sues New York Yankees for $10 million after being hit in head by bat
item.description: A fan is suing the Yankees, claiming she suffered permanent injuries when a bat flew into the stands and struck her head.

item.title: Surveillance video captures golf cart arson in Washington state
item.description: A witness to the incident said the man claimed he was with the fire department.
